text: Is there any influenza data in the E. coli records here?

To be sure I deliver the right answer:  

• By “E. coli records” do you mean genomic / sequencing datasets that are annotated as Escherichia coli in resources such as the European Nucleotide Archive (ENA) or NCBI SRA?  

• And by “influenza data” are you looking for evidence that those E. coli datasets also contain sequences matching influenza viruses (e.g. metagenomic co-infections), or do you mean something else (for example, influenza gene insertions carried on E. coli plasmids)?  

Let me know which specific databases and what kind of “influenza data” you have in mind, and I’ll run the appropriate searches.
